description: Record that you filed one of your cases in Trustpilot's portal. Needs your live claim (claim_packet) and, in manual mode, the human check: who verified the packet, the exact draft_version (the packet's human_check.draft_version), and every checklist item marked confirm. When the packet's reason has a subtype, human_check.subreason may name the subtype id you selected in the portal; it confirms the subreason item, and one other than the packet's replaces the case's subtype (it must be one the reasons file documents for that reason). When the packet's reason has subreason_choice instead (screening kept no subtype), human_check.subreason is required: the id of the subtype you selected, from subreason_choice.options. A report filed under Defamation needs the business's statement that the accusation in the highlighted words is untrue: unless the checklist shows it given with the approval (accusation_untrue ok), confirm accusation_untrue and name in human_check.attested_by the person at the business who made it; without it nothing is recorded, so get it before you submit the report. (capability: cases.mark_filed_own)
name: mark_filed
